title: Coupled Penrose vanishing on the round four-sphere

items.title: Coupled Penrose vanishing on the round four-sphere
items.statement: Assume AC. Let S4 have positive stereographic orientation for z1=x0+ix1,z2=x2+ix3 and round metric. Let E be any smooth finite-rank Hermitian bundle with smooth unitary ASD connection A. On CP3 use the incidence μ1=z1λ1−bar(z2)λ2, μ2=z2λ1+bar(z1)λ2 and infinity λ=0. Suppose a holomorphic bundle F is smoothly identified with π*E and its Dolbeault operator is the vertical ordinary derivative and the A-horizontal alpha-plane operator. Then H1(CP3,F(-2))=H1(CP3,F∨(-2))=0. Include arbitrary reducible and flat summands. No GAGA, monad or inverse ADHM normal form is assumed.

obligations: Construct the actual coupled relative Dolbeault/de Rham correspondence complex on the double fibration, with defined sheaves, differentials, domains and resolutions.
Prove local/fiber exactness and the global spectral-sequence edge map, including injectivity rather than merely writing a fiber contour integral.
Prove overlap, global smoothness and gauge/dual naturality of the transform on S4.
Derive the full coupled conformal Laplacian/Weitzenböck formula, scalar coefficient and sign for the stated round scalar-curvature convention; do not copy the source R/8 without verification.
Use compact integration by parts and positivity to prove vanishing for F and F∨, including flat/reducible factors.
